Priya M: @Leo welcome! quick intake: dataset size, PHI fraction, must-have constraints?
Leo (SilverStream): thanks. ~88k docs, ~7% PHI (SSNs + clinician notes). Private deployment (eu-central-1) + HSM required. hard rule: never assert diagnoses or recommend treatment.
Sam C: noted. can we do a 2k canary subset for safety + perf? also need exportable redaction audit logs.
Leo (SilverStream): 2k canary OK. need toggle for aggressive redaction and an audit CSV. we'll provide a written redaction policy.
Olga (CS Manager): flagging renewal risk 1% churn signal they mentioned renewal discussions next quarter; poor accuracy or safety slip could jeopardize upsell. recommend focused enablement + weekly check-ins during canary.
Priya M: proposed plan:
- Day 0-3: ingest 2k canary, run safety/PII redaction tests
- Day 4-6: private canary deploy eu-central-1 + 48h perf soak
- Week 2: enablement + SLA review + renewal health call
Sam C: we'll need eng tickets for model variant (7b-quant-finetune), reranker integration, redaction audit export, and HSM key binding. @ticket-bot can you open?
ticket-bot: created TKT-7124 (canary infra eu-central-1), ML-3021 (safety eval harness + redaction audit), SEC-121 (HSM KMS binding). invites sent to Leo.
Sam C: ran a small internal pilot on a random subset, quick snapshot:
```
Entity F1: 0.78
Hallucination: 5.1% (target <2%)
Latency p95: 540ms (target <450ms)
Cost per 1k tokens: 1.3x baseline
```
Priya M: hallucination and latency above targets. recommend adding lightweight reranker + KB grounding to reduce factual errors, clamp temperature to 0.2 and max_new_tokens to 120, and enable prefix-KV caching to improve p95.
Leo (SilverStream): safety is top priority; reranker + grounding fine. aim for p95 <500ms but don't sacrifice the no-diagnosis rule.
Sam C: action items:
- Sam to run 2k safety eval and post results by Thu
- Priya to draft KB grounding + reranker tuning recommendations
- Olga to schedule enablement deck and renewal outreach prep
- Leo to upload redaction policy + 2k canary bundle by EOD tomorrow
Leo (SilverStream): will upload bundle and policy. thanks everyone.
Sam C: great 44d I'll update the thread when artifacts are up.
